entries.name: buffer
entries.signature: export declare function buffer(sink: Sink, options?: { readonly maxRecords?: number; readonly flushIntervalMs?: number; readonly overflow?: 'drop-oldest' | 'drop-newest'; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Batches records and writes them to `sink` every `flushIntervalMs`, in order. When `maxRecords` are waiting, `overflow` says which record is dropped.

entries.name: CategoryRule
entries.signature: export type CategoryRule<C extends string> = { readonly level?: LevelName; readonly channels?: readonly C[]; /** `false`: start from no channels instead of the parent's. */ readonly inherit?: boolean; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A rule for one category and its descendants (RFC §8.1).

entries.name: Censor
entries.signature: export type Censor = string | ((value: Value, path: string) => Value);

entries.name: ChannelName
entries.signature: export type ChannelName = Register extends { logging: Configured<infer C>; } ? C : string;
entries.jsdocSummary: The app's channel names once `Register` is declared; any string before that.

entries.name: configure
entries.signature: export declare function configure<const C extends string>(config: LogConfig<C>, options?: ConfigureOptions): Configured<C>;
entries.jsdocSummary: Configures the default instance, once, at the app entry. A second call throws `ARKI_LOG_E001`, unless it comes from the same `owner` (a dev server re-running the entry).

entries.name: Configured
entries.signature: export type Configured<C extends string> = { readonly [CHANNELS]?: C; flush(): Promise<void>; /** Flushes, then closes every sink. The instance is then unconfigured again. */ close(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number; }): Promise<void>; /** Swaps the configuration atomically; the old sinks that are not reused drain and close. */ reconfigure<const D extends string>(config: LogConfig<D>): Promise<void>; };
entries.jsdocSummary: The handle `configure()` returns (RFC §8.1).

entries.name: ConfigureOptions
entries.signature: export type ConfigureOptions = { /** * Who configures, usually the entry's `import.meta.url`. When the same owner * calls `configure()` again (a dev server re-running the entry), the new setup * replaces the old one and the old handle goes stale. Any other second call * still throws `ARKI_LOG_E001`. */ readonly owner?: string; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Options for `configure()`.

entries.name: consoleSink
entries.signature: export declare function consoleSink(options?: { readonly format?: Formatter; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Writes to `console`. With `format`, each record is one formatted line. Without it (browser mode), the message is followed by the fields object and the error, so devtools can expand them.

entries.name: ContextStore
entries.signature: export type ContextStore = { get(): Fields | undefined; run<R>(fields: Fields, fn: () => R): R; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Where scoped context (`withContext`) lives. The core ships a synchronous store; `@arki/log/node` ships `asyncContext()`.

entries.name: createLogging
entries.signature: export declare function createLogging(): Logging;
entries.jsdocSummary: A private logging instance with the same functions as the default one (RFC §8.1).

entries.name: deduplicate
entries.signature: export declare function deduplicate(sink: Sink, options?: { readonly windowMs?: number; readonly key?: (record: LogRecord) => string; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Writes the same record (by `key`, default level + category + template) once per `windowMs`. When the window closes, a summary record says how many were suppressed.

entries.name: dropWhen
entries.signature: export declare function dropWhen(predicate: (record: LogRecord) => boolean): Processor;
entries.jsdocSummary: Drops records the predicate matches.

entries.name: enrich
entries.signature: export declare function enrich(fn: (record: LogRecord) => Fields): Processor;
entries.jsdocSummary: Adds fields from `fn`. Never overwrites a key the record already has.

entries.name: EnvSettings
entries.signature: export type EnvSettings = { /** `LOG_LEVEL`: replaces `default.level`. */ readonly level?: LevelName; /** `DEBUG`: categories lowered to `debug`, and categories excluded with `-`. `''` is the root. */ readonly debug?: { readonly include: readonly string[]; readonly exclude: readonly string[]; }; /** `NO_COLOR`: `false` when set. Pass it to `pretty({ colors })`; formatters do not read config. */ readonly colors?: boolean; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Settings read from the environment by `fromEnv()` in `@arki/log/node` (RFC §8.5).

entries.name: FailureLike
entries.signature: export type FailureLike = { readonly code: string; readonly message: string; readonly data: unknown; readonly status: number; readonly remediation: string | undefined; readonly cause?: unknown; readonly '~failure': true; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A failure value from `@arki/failure`, by shape: `@arki/log` keeps zero dependencies, so it knows a failure by its `'~failure'` brand. Logged as a field, it prints `code`, `message`, `status`, `data`, `remediation` and its cause chain as `causes`.

entries.name: FieldInput
entries.signature: export type FieldInput = Fields | (() => Fields);
entries.jsdocSummary: Fields, or a synchronous thunk that builds them only when the level is enabled (RFC §5.4).

entries.name: Fields
entries.signature: export type Fields = Readonly<Record<string, Value>>;
entries.jsdocSummary: One field map per record, as in OpenTelemetry.

entries.name: FieldsArg
entries.signature: export type FieldsArg<T extends string, Bound extends string> = string extends T ? [fields?: FieldInput] : [Exclude<PlaceholderNames<T>, Bound>] extends [never] ? [fields?: FieldInput] : [ fields: PlaceholderFields<Exclude<PlaceholderNames<T>, Bound>> | (() => PlaceholderFields<Exclude<PlaceholderNames<T>, Bound>>) ];
entries.jsdocSummary: The fields argument of a log call. A placeholder must be satisfied by the call's fields or by fields already bound with `.with()` (the `Bound` keys). A template typed as plain `string` accepts any fields.

entries.name: fingersCrossed
entries.signature: export declare function fingersCrossed(sink: Sink, options?: { readonly triggerAt?: LevelName; readonly captureFrom?: LevelName; readonly maxRecords?: number; readonly scope?: 'context' | 'global'; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Monolog's fingers-crossed handler (RFC §7.1). Records from `captureFrom` up are kept in a bounded ring. A record at `triggerAt` or above writes the ring in order, then itself; later records in that scope pass straight through. With `scope: 'context'` there is one ring per `withContext` scope (records outside any scope share the global ring); a scope that ends without an error leaves its ring to be garbage-collected.

entries.name: Formatter
entries.signature: export type Formatter = (record: LogRecord) => string;
entries.jsdocSummary: Turns a record into one line of text.

entries.name: getLogger
entries.signature: export declare function getLogger(category?: string): Logger;
entries.jsdocSummary: A logger for a `:`-separated category; no argument is the root category `''`. Safe at module scope.

entries.name: json
entries.signature: export declare function json(): Formatter;
entries.jsdocSummary: One JSON object per record: `time`, `level`, `levelName`, `category`, `template`, `message`, then `eventName`, `body`, `fields`, `error`, trace ids and `resource` when present. Bound fields are written from JSON cached once per `.with()`. When layers share a key, the merged map is written instead, so every key appears once (RFC §5.2 precedence).

entries.name: Level
entries.signature: export declare const Level: { readonly trace: 1; readonly debug: 5; readonly info: 9; readonly warn: 13; readonly error: 17; readonly fatal: 21; };
entries.jsdocSummary: The six levels, with their OpenTelemetry severity numbers (RFC §4).

entries.name: LevelInput
entries.signature: export type LevelInput = LevelName | number;
entries.jsdocSummary: A level name, or an OpenTelemetry severity number from 1 to 24.

entries.name: LevelName
entries.signature: export type LevelName = keyof typeof Level;

entries.name: lineSink
entries.signature: export declare function lineSink(write: (line: string) => void, options?: { readonly format?: Formatter; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Formats each record (JSON by default) and hands the line to `write`.

entries.name: LOG_ERROR_CODES
entries.signature: export declare const LOG_ERROR_CODES: { /** * `configure()` ran a second time on the same logging instance. * * @fix Call `configure()` once at the app entry, with `{ owner: import.meta.url }` so a dev re-run of the entry is allowed. Use `reconfigure()` on its handle to change the setup. * @verify bun run test -- src/core/logging.test.ts */ readonly alreadyConfigured: 'ARKI_LOG_E001'; /** * A category rule or `to()` names a channel that `configure({ channels })` does not define. * * @fix Add the channel to `configure({ channels })`, or use one of the defined names. * @verify bun run test -- src/core/logging.test.ts */ readonly unknownChannel: 'ARKI_LOG_E002'; /** * A level is neither one of the six names nor a severity number from 1 to 24. * * @fix Use `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` or `fatal`, or a number from 1 to 24. * @verify bun run test -- src/core/logging.test.ts */ readonly invalidLevel: 'ARKI_LOG_E003'; /** * `fakeLog()` ran while another fake was active, or `configure()` ran while a fake owns the instance. * * @fix Restore the active fake first with `restore()` or `using`. Keep one fake at a time. * @verify bun run test -- src/testing/fake.test.ts */ readonly fakeActive: 'ARKI_LOG_E004'; /** * `reconfigure()` was called on a handle that no longer owns the configuration. * * @fix Use the handle returned by the latest `configure()` call. * @verify bun run test -- src/core/logging.test.ts */ readonly staleHandle: 'ARKI_LOG_E005'; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Coded errors for mistakes in logging setup. A log call itself never throws these unless it is given a level that does not exist.

entries.name: LogConfig
entries.signature: export type LogConfig<C extends string> = { readonly channels: Readonly<Record<C, Sink>>; readonly default: { readonly level: LevelName; readonly channels: readonly NoInfer<C>[]; }; readonly categories?: Readonly<Record<string, CategoryRule<NoInfer<C>>>>; readonly processors?: readonly Processor[]; readonly resource?: Fields; readonly context?: ContextStore; readonly trace?: TraceSource; readonly env?: EnvSettings; };
entries.jsdocSummary: The argument of `configure()` (RFC §8.1).

entries.name: LogError
entries.signature: export declare class LogError extends Error { readonly code: LogErrorCode; readonly remediation: string; constructor(args: { readonly code: LogErrorCode; readonly message: string; readonly remediation: string; }); }

entries.name: LogErrorCode
entries.signature: export type LogErrorCode = (typeof LOG_ERROR_CODES)[keyof typeof LOG_ERROR_CODES];

entries.name: LogEvent
entries.signature: export type LogEvent = { readonly level: LevelInput; readonly eventName: string; readonly body?: Value; readonly fields?: Fields; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A structured event (RFC §5.5).

entries.name: logfmt
entries.signature: export declare function logfmt(): Formatter;
entries.jsdocSummary: `key=value` pairs: `time`, `level`, `category`, `msg`, then fields, `error` and trace ids.

entries.name: Logger
entries.signature: export type Logger<Bound extends string = never> = { readonly category: string; trace<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; debug<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; info<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; warn<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; error<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; /** Logs an error; the template is the error's message. */ error(error: Error, fields?: FieldInput): void; fatal<T extends string>(template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; /** Logs an error; the template is the error's message. It only writes; it never exits. */ fatal(error: Error, fields?: FieldInput): void; log<T extends string>(level: LevelInput, template: T, ...fields: FieldsArg<T, Bound>): void; isEnabled(level: LevelInput): boolean; emit(event: LogEvent): void; /** A logger with bound fields. The original is unchanged. */ with<F extends Fields>(fields: F): Logger<Bound | (keyof F & string)>; /** Extends the category path: `'arki:kv'` → `'arki:kv:redis'`. */ child(name: string): Logger<Bound>; /** Stamps this trace on every record. */ withTrace(trace: TraceContext): Logger<Bound>; /** Sends records only to these channels, instead of the category's channels. */ to(...channels: readonly [ChannelName, ...ChannelName[]]): Logger<Bound>; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A logger (RFC §3). `Bound` holds the keys bound with `.with()`, which satisfy placeholders.

entries.name: Logging
entries.signature: export type Logging = { getLogger(category?: string): Logger; configure<const C extends string>(config: LogConfig<C>, options?: ConfigureOptions): Configured<C>; withContext<R>(fields: Fields, fn: () => R): R; shareContext(fields: Fields): void; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A logging instance: the default one behind the global functions, or a private one from `createLogging()`.

entries.name: LogRecord
entries.signature: export type LogRecord = Readonly<{ /** Epoch milliseconds. */ time: number; /** 1..24 (OTel SeverityNumber). */ level: number; /** OTel SeverityText. */ levelName: LevelName; category: string; /** `''` for `emit()`. */ template: string; eventName?: string; body?: Value; fields: Fields; error?: Error; traceId?: string; spanId?: string; traceFlags?: number; resource: Fields; /** Renders the template on first call, then memoised. */ message(): string; }>;
entries.jsdocSummary: The record handed to processors, sinks and formatters (RFC §5.6).

entries.name: memorySink
entries.signature: export declare function memorySink(): MemorySink;

entries.name: MemorySink
entries.signature: export type MemorySink = Sink & { readonly records: readonly LogRecord[]; clear(): void; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A sink that keeps records in memory.

entries.name: PlaceholderNames
entries.signature: export type PlaceholderNames<T extends string, Acc extends string = never> = T extends `${string}{${infer Rest}` ? Rest extends `{${infer After}` ? PlaceholderNames<After, Acc> : Rest extends `${infer Name}}${infer After}` ? Name extends '' | `${string}{${string}` ? PlaceholderNames<Rest, Acc> : PlaceholderNames<After, Acc | Name> : Acc : Acc;
entries.jsdocSummary: The placeholder names in a literal template. `{{` is a literal brace; `{}` and a name that contains `{` are not placeholders. Tail-recursive, so long templates do not hit the instantiation-depth limit. Mirrors `parseTemplate`.

entries.name: pretty
entries.signature: export declare function pretty(options?: { readonly colors?: boolean; }): Formatter;
entries.jsdocSummary: Human output: `12:00:00.123 INFO arki:kv connecting to db.local pool=main`. Placeholder values are highlighted; fields not used by the template follow. Errors print their stack and cause chain. Colors are off unless asked for.

entries.name: Processor
entries.signature: export type Processor = (record: LogRecord) => LogRecord | null;
entries.jsdocSummary: Returns the record (or a changed copy from `updateRecord`), or `null` to drop it.

entries.name: RecordChanges
entries.signature: export type RecordChanges = { readonly time?: number; readonly level?: number; readonly template?: string; readonly eventName?: string; readonly body?: Value; readonly fields?: Fields; readonly error?: Error | undefined; };
entries.jsdocSummary: What `updateRecord` may change.

entries.name: redact
entries.signature: export declare function redact(paths: readonly string[], options?: { readonly censor?: Censor; }): Processor;
entries.jsdocSummary: Replaces the values at dot paths (RFC §7). `*` matches one level of keys or array items (`'*.token'`). Paths are matched against the fields and the serialised error. The copy renders its message from the redacted fields, so a secret never reaches the message text.

entries.name: Register
entries.signature: export interface Register { }
entries.jsdocSummary: Register your app's logging handle to type-check channel names in `to()` (RFC §8.4):

entries.name: renderTemplate
entries.signature: export declare function renderTemplate(template: string, fields: Fields): string;
entries.jsdocSummary: Renders a template. A placeholder with no value (absent or `undefined`) stays `{name}`.

entries.name: serializeError
entries.signature: export declare function serializeError(error: Error): Fields;
entries.jsdocSummary: Turns an `Error` into plain fields (RFC §5.3): `name`, `message`, `stack`, `code`, own enumerable fields, the `cause` chain and `AggregateError.errors`. Depth and cycles are bounded. Own accessors are never called, except the engine's `stack`, `name` and `message`, which are read inside `try`.

entries.name: serializeFailure
entries.signature: export declare function serializeFailure(failure: FailureLike): Fields;
entries.jsdocSummary: Turns a failure from `@arki/failure` into plain fields: `code`, `message`, `status`, `data`, `remediation`, and `causes`, its cause chain as a list from nearest to root. A link is a failure's fields or an error's fields; an error's own causes join the same list. The list stops after {@link MAX_CAUSE_LINKS} links (`'[MaxDepth]'`) or at a cycle (`'[Circular]'`).

entries.name: shareContext
entries.signature: export declare function shareContext(fields: Fields): void;
entries.jsdocSummary: App-wide fields on every record. Later calls add to (and override) earlier ones.

entries.name: Sink
entries.signature: export type Sink = { write(record: LogRecord): void; flush?(): void | Promise<void>; close?(): void | Promise<void>; /** The sink's own floor. */ level?: LevelName; /** The sink's own processors, run after the global ones. */ processors?: readonly Processor[]; /** * Records from this level up reach this sink even when the category's level is higher. * Set by `fingersCrossed`; it never lowers other sinks' levels. */ captureFrom?: LevelName; };
entries.jsdocSummary: An output (RFC §7). `write` is synchronous; a sink that does async IO buffers inside itself.

entries.name: TraceContext
entries.signature: export type TraceContext = { readonly traceId: string; readonly spanId: string; readonly traceFlags?: number; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A trace context stamped on a record.

entries.name: TraceSource
entries.signature: export type TraceSource = () => TraceContext | undefined;
entries.jsdocSummary: Reads the active trace when a record is built (`@arki/log/otel` provides one).

entries.name: updateRecord
entries.signature: export declare function updateRecord(record: LogRecord, changes: RecordChanges): LogRecord;
entries.jsdocSummary: A copy of a record with some parts replaced, for processors. The copy renders its message from its own fields, so a redacted value never reaches `message()`.

entries.name: Value
entries.signature: export type Value = string | number | boolean | null | undefined | bigint | Date | Error | FailureLike | readonly Value[] | { readonly [key: string]: Value; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A field value (RFC §5.2).

entries.name: withContext
entries.signature: export declare function withContext<R>(fields: Fields, fn: () => R): R;
entries.jsdocSummary: Runs `fn` with fields every record inside carries. Async code needs `asyncContext()` installed.

entries.name: asyncContext
entries.signature: export declare function asyncContext(): ContextStore;
entries.jsdocSummary: A context store on `AsyncLocalStorage`: `withContext` scopes survive `await`.

entries.name: file
entries.signature: export declare function file(options: { readonly path: string; readonly format?: Formatter; }): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Appends lines (JSON by default) to a file, opened when this is called.

entries.name: fromEnv
entries.signature: export declare function fromEnv(env?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>): { readonly env: EnvSettings; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Reads the environment, only when called (RFC §8.5): `LOG_LEVEL` (the default level), `DEBUG` (`arki:kv:*,-arki:kv:noisy`: each match lowers that category to `debug`; `-` excludes) and `NO_COLOR`. Spread the result into `configure()`.

entries.name: stderr
entries.signature: export declare function stderr(options?: FdSinkOptions): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Writes lines (JSON by default) to standard error.

entries.name: stdout
entries.signature: export declare function stdout(options?: FdSinkOptions): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: Writes lines (JSON by default) to standard output.

entries.name: otelSink
entries.signature: export declare function otelSink(loggerProvider: LoggerProvider): Sink;
entries.jsdocSummary: A sink that sends records to the OpenTelemetry Logs API. Each record keeps its severity, its rendered message (or its structured body for `emit()`), its fields as attributes plus `log.category` and `log.template`, its trace ids, and the configured resource fields (as attributes; a record's own fields win on a clash).

entries.name: otelTrace
entries.signature: export declare function otelTrace(): TraceSource;
entries.jsdocSummary: A trace source that reads the active span from `@opentelemetry/api` when a record is built. Pass it as `configure({ trace: otelTrace() })`.

entries.name: CapturedRecord
entries.signature: export type CapturedRecord = { readonly record: LogRecord; readonly channels: readonly string[]; };
entries.jsdocSummary: A record and the channel names it was routed to.

entries.name: fakeLog
entries.signature: export declare function fakeLog(): FakeLog;
entries.jsdocSummary: Takes over the default instance: level `trace`, every category captured, no sink written. `restore()` (or `using`) gives it back. One fake at a time per process; a second one throws `ARKI_LOG_E004`.

entries.name: FakeLog
entries.signature: export type FakeLog = { /** Every record, from every category, at every level. */ readonly records: readonly LogRecord[]; /** Every record with the channels it was routed to (`to()`, else the configured category rule). */ readonly captured: readonly CapturedRecord[]; assertLogged(match: RecordMatch): void; assertNotLogged(match: RecordMatch): void; assertSentTo(channel: string, match?: RecordMatch): void; /** Gives the default instance back, with its configuration as it was. */ restore(): void; [Symbol.dispose](): void; };

entries.name: LogAssertionError
entries.signature: export declare class LogAssertionError extends Error { constructor(message: string); }

entries.name: RecordMatch
entries.signature: export type RecordMatch = { readonly level?: LevelName; readonly category?: string; readonly template?: string; readonly message?: string; readonly eventName?: string; readonly fields?: Fields; };
entries.jsdocSummary: What a captured record must match. Every given part must match; `fields` matches a subset.
